_README: This is the control panel for the daily Meta Ads automation. Fill in every value marked TODO. All money values are in INR (whole rupees unless noted). The daily agent reads THIS file first, every run.

campaign._note: New daily ads are created INSIDE the target ad sets, so they share each ad set's existing ~500 INR/day budget and inherit its targeting. The agent does not add budget without approval.

daily_new_ad.message:

daily_new_ad.headline: Wedding Photography se 1 Crore — possible hai, agar sahi plan ho

approval.approval_wait: The agent stops after sending the proposal. It only creates/changes ads on the next run (or an immediate reply) where you have written APPROVE.
